_comment: Hand-authored, action-first feature tips for features native to Kiro Crew (keyboard shortcuts, Settings toggles, config keys) that have no docs/*.md entry and so can never surface through the doc-scan catalog. Each tip's body ends with the exact thing to do. An optional 'action' object ({kind:'route', label, route}) renders a one-click button that navigates to the exact settings page/control; tips whose feature has no navigable destination (a keyboard shortcut or a mid-turn composer control) omit 'action' and render body only. A curated tip that wants a 'learn more' doc link MUST use 'doc_link' (rendering-only), never 'doc': 'doc' is the tip's dismissal identity, and a curated tip claiming a catalog-owned doc there would suppress the catalog's own tip for that doc on dismissal. Loaded by kiro_crew.tips._load_curated_tips; the string fields are validated like generated tips, and 'action' is validated separately by _sanitize_tip_action (kind must be 'route'; route must be an internal path).

tips.title: Work two sessions side by side
tips.body: Run two chats at once. Turn on **Settings › Chat › Split View**, then press **⌘D** (**Ctrl+D**) to split the focused pane. Off by default.

tips.title: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
tips.body: Press **⌘K** (**Ctrl+K**) to open Search Everywhere — sessions, pages, skills, prompts, artifacts, settings, and runnable actions in one box. Prefer the IntelliJ-style double-tap **Shift**? Turn it on in **Settings › Shortcuts**.

tips.title: Steer a running turn
tips.body: While the agent is working, open the send button's **▾** menu: **Steer** injects your message into the live turn right away; **Queue** runs it after the current turn finishes.

tips.title: Switch to CLI-style output
tips.body: Prefer terminal-style, line-by-line output over chat bubbles? Set **Settings › Display › Interface → CLI**. Applies to this browser.

tips.title: Cut session startup time
tips.body: Pre-spawn agent processes so new sessions start instantly instead of cold-starting. Enable with `kirocrew config set session.pool_size 2`. Off (0) by default.

tips.title: Use less memory with the MCP gateway
tips.body: Route MCP tools through one shared broker instead of a copy per session to cut RAM. Enable the **Shared MCP gateway** toggle (Developer › MCP Pool — requires Developer Mode), or run `kirocrew config set mcp_gateway.enabled true`.

tips.title: Tune how many subagents run at once
tips.body: `agent.max_subagents` caps concurrent subagents. **0 = auto-size** to your machine's memory and CPU; pin a number with `kirocrew config set agent.max_subagents 4`.

tips.title: See local OpenTelemetry metrics
tips.body: Run `kirocrew config set telemetry.enabled true` to record OpenTelemetry metrics under `~/.kiro/crew/metrics`, viewable in the Telemetry panel. Stays on your machine — nothing is exported.

tips.title: Run crons with no LLM
tips.body: A scheduled job can run a shell `command` or a Python `script` directly — no model, zero tokens. Ideal for polling, cleanup, and health checks.

tips.title: Manage worktrees and pods from the dashboard
tips.body: Building Kiro Crew itself? Enable the **Dev Fleet** app under **Apps → Installed → Show**, then open **Dev Fleet** to manage git worktrees and isolated test pods.

tips.title: Add new capabilities with Apps
tips.body: Open **Apps → Browse** and click **Enable** to add an app's agents, skills, and crons in one step.

tips.title: See what each session is spending
tips.body: A task manager for your agent: live CPU and memory per session, credits spent, and a Storage screen for what each session holds on disk. Open **Developer › System** — turn on **Developer Mode** in **Settings › Developer** to keep it in the sidebar.

tips.title: Run commands without leaving the dashboard
tips.body: Click the **Terminal** icon in the sidebar for a tabbed shell that opens in the selected session's project directory; select any output and **Send to chat**. Pick your shell, font, and size in **Settings › Display**.

tips.title: Keep the UI the agent builds for you
tips.body: Widgets, generated images, and documents can be saved as **Artifacts** — each gets its own page, a version history, and a companion chat for iterating on it. Browse them under **Artifacts**.

tips.title: Use the dashboard in your language
tips.body: Switch the whole dashboard to another language in **Settings › Display › Language**, or leave it on **Auto** to follow your browser and OS.

tips.title: Turn repeated work into a skill
tips.body: Let Kiro Crew draft a reusable skill whenever a finished session contains a multi-step procedure worth repeating. Enable **Auto-generate skills from sessions** in **Settings › Skills** — drafts wait in a review queue and never go live without your approval. Off by default.

tips.title: Use a different model for background work
tips.body: Background jobs and sub-agents can run on their own model and reasoning effort, separate from your chat. Set **Background Model** in **Settings › Chat**; a role you leave unset stays on `auto`.

tips.title: Let the agent use a real browser
tips.body: Install the **Playwright CLI** from **Settings › Browser** and the agent can open pages, read them, and fill forms — you watch, and can take over, in the chat's **Browser** panel.

tips.title: Let the agent drive a desktop app
tips.body: On macOS, the agent can read a native app's window through accessibility and click, type, and scroll in it. Turn on **Enable computer use** in **Settings › Computer Use** — off until you do, and an agent cannot enable it itself.

tips.title: Triage GitHub and GitLab issues
tips.body: Enable the **Issue Radar** app under **Apps**, connect a repository, and triage issues and pull requests from the dashboard — what the agent finds stays on the issue's card. Off until you enable it.

tips.title: Reach another machine's Kiro Crew
tips.body: Add another Kiro Crew gateway over SSH or AWS SSM in **Settings › Remote Crew**, then switch between instances from the header.
